# n8n Workflow Manager

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/n8n-workflow-manager
Package name: n8n-workflow-manager
Version: 0.2.6
CLI command: n8n-manager
Primary audience: n8n users, workflow automation teams, local-first AI agents, and developers who need to inspect, document, create, or sync n8n workflows.

Summary:
n8n Workflow Manager is a local-first Python package with a visual editor, REST API, CLI, SQLite workflow-version and decision history, rollback, Markdown/JSON exports, validated templates, and server-scoped n8n sync. Some creation, import, template, and pull paths use default non-empty decision rationales; update, rollback, delete, and push require a non-empty caller rationale. Decision records document intent and do not establish human approval.

Architecture & Invariants:
- Local-first default: binds to 127.0.0.1:8100 by default. Configured n8n REST connections and remote setup over SSH use the network; there is no zero-egress guarantee.
- Non-Elevation: runs with unprivileged user permissions (RunAsInvoker).
- Decision history: mutations record non-empty rationales; some creation/import/template/pull paths use defaults. SQLite rows are ordinary local data, not immutable or tamper-proof, and a rationale is not human approval.
- Local rollback: restores a retained workflow version in the local database only. A separate explicit push updates remote n8n; deletion removes local workflow versions, and history is not a disaster-recovery guarantee.
- Dual-Mermaid Modeling: high-level architecture diagram and interactive sequence diagram with autonumber.
- All eleven README languages retain their 17-item navigation and section structure.
- Visual Interface Walkthrough: bundled screenshots of dashboard and interactive vis.js graph inspector.
- Target Audience Personas: tailored for sysadmins, AI architects, compliance officers, and SREs.
- 10-row project capability and boundary table; it makes no competitor product claims.
- Security response policy: 48-hour initial response and five-business-day triage commitments in SECURITY.md; policy commitments, not a runtime guarantee or patch deadline.

Notes:
- This repository is not the n8n project itself. It is a companion manager for imported or connected n8n workflows. It is an independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by n8n GmbH; "n8n" is a trademark of its respective owner.
- The web UI, CLI, and REST API are English; README documentation is available in the eleven languages listed above. The bundled browser library vis-network is third-party code under its own license, see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
- The FastAPI service binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and can be configured to bind elsewhere. Loopback binding does not block configured n8n REST or SSH connections.
- The MCP server is maintained separately as n8n-manager-mcp.
- Search engines may surface ellmos-ai/n8n-manager-mcp or third-party n8n deployment tools first; this repository is the Python dashboard and CLI package for visual inspection, documentation export, and multi-server workflow sync.
- Verification status: 210+ Pytest unit, integration & contract tests passing (100% green).
